summary: BP p.l.c. furnished a Form 6-K to the SEC reporting routine Director/PDMR share transactions under Article 19 of the UK Market Abuse Regulation. The filing covers share acquisitions by CFO Kate Thomson (105,939 shares at 3.15 GBP via option exercise) and small ShareMatch plan purchases by other executives. No corporate event, strategic action, or material special situation is disclosed. The filing is administrative, not a special-situation report, so 'None' is the appropriate category. No deal terms or structural details apply.
